# launch_pegasus

[← Command index](README.md)

Start the Pegasus game frontend installed by setup_tools.

## Synopsis

```
launch_pegasus [options]
```

## Description

Runs the Pegasus program from the tools directory, with its own folder as the working
directory and the current environment passed through. It also sets
`JOYBOX_LAUNCH_JSON` to the JoyBox launcher command, which the `launch:` lines in the
Pegasus metadata files JoyBox writes call to start a game.

It waits for Pegasus to exit and logs an error if it exits with a non-zero code. It
takes only the common options.

## Options

### Common options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-v, --verbose` | Enable verbose mode. |
| `-p, --pretend_run` | Do a pretend run with no permanent changes. |
| `-x, --exit_on_failure` | Enable exit on failure mode. |
| `--no-preview` | Skip the preview confirmation prompt. |

## Examples

### Start Pegasus

```bash
launch_pegasus
```

### Dry run without starting Pegasus

```bash
launch_pegasus -p -v
```

## Notes

- Pegasus must be installed first (`setup_tools -k Pegasus`); the command exits with an error if it is not found.
